news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.47 (vs ₹2.18 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.47 (up from ₹2.18 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹297.9m (up ₹288.5m from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹52.4m (up ₹69.6m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 18% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 48% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 13% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
